podcast.body: Featured on the *Power Windows* album, this song's lyrics by Neil Peart were influenced by a 1936 novel from John Dos Passos, part of a trilogy about 12 characters during the Great Depression. Peart adapted the novel's sentiments to reflect the growing corporate greed of the 1980s global economy, presenting a theme not typical of rock and roll. "The big money was inspired by a 1936 novel from John DePasso's."
